#!/usr/bin/env python3
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Parse the RSS file
tree = ET.parse('/mnt/e/DEV/repos/auto-agents/cli/tmp/rss.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

# Get all item elements and extract titles
titles = []
for item in root.findall('.//item'):
    title_elem = item.find('title')
    if title_elem is not None:
        titles.append(title_elem.text)

# Print numbered list to console
for i, title in enumerate(titles, 1):
    print(f"{i}. {title}")

# Save output to file
with open('/mnt/e/DEV/repos/auto-agents/cli/tmp/titles.txt', 'w') as f:
    for i, title in enumerate(titles, 1):
        f.write(f"{i}. {title}\n")

print("\nOutput saved to /mnt/e/DEV/repos/auto-agents/cli/tmp/titles.txt")
